title: 第14章 梦里的声音，马小桃的袭击
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一旁的王言很是惊讶，没想到比赛结束得这么快。

他发现王冬儿对战斗的观察非常细致，敏捷度也不错，能够及时躲开对方的攻击。

更重要的是王冬儿和萧萧的配合非常好，一前一后夹击，即便是大部分新生都没办法反应过来。

至于霍雨浩，他并没有评价，因为他并没有看到霍雨浩出手。但实际上，这场对战作用最大的就是霍雨浩。

“我们赢了！”萧萧非常开心。

王冬儿跑过去抱住了霍雨浩。

“雨浩，我们赢了。”

感受到王冬儿的温度，霍雨浩红了脸。

“嗯，赢了。”

第一次赢得比赛，霍雨浩也非常开心。

看着他们二人，萧萧双手握拳放在嘴巴前面偷笑着。

第一天为了让新生们适应，所以只有一场比赛。打完这一场，他们就可以回去休息了。

王冬儿三人来到食堂，买了一大堆的食物，好好庆祝一下首次胜利。

“明天有四场比赛呢，我们还得加油。”

萧萧一边大口吃着食物，一边说道。

也不知道学校怎么安排的，一天打四场，也太累了一些。

如果对手实力都差不多，怕是打到第四场就直接没力气了。

“话说我们不用留下来看其他组的比赛吗？万一之后遇到了，也可以更好地应对啊。”霍雨浩说道。

“怎么，你对我们的实力没有信心吗？无论对手是谁，我们都能赢。”王冬儿很有自信。

“没错，都能赢。”萧萧附和。

霍雨浩也被王冬儿的自信感染了。

“好，明天一起加油！”

大家一起开心地享受美食。

考核的这几天，霍雨浩要全力准备，所以就没有去卖烤鱼了。

等到了晚上，两人又坐在床上开始一起修炼。

霍雨浩感觉自己的魂力与王冬儿的魂力融合得越来越融洽了，他们就像是融为了一体。

“王冬儿～”

“冬儿～”

修炼时，王冬儿忽然感觉到好像是有人在叫自己，声音非常熟悉。

“你是谁？是谁在叫我？”

“王冬儿。”

王冬儿似乎听到了王秋儿的声音。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Yan on the side was very surprised. He didn't expect the game to end so quickly.

He found that Wang Dong'er observed the battle very carefully and had good agility, able to dodge the opponent's attacks in time.

What's more important is that Wang Dong'er and Xiao Xiao cooperate very well. They attack one after another, and even most of the freshmen can't react.

As for Huo Yuhao, he did not comment because he did not see Huo Yuhao take action.But in fact, Huo Yuhao was the one who played the biggest role in this battle.

"We won!" Xiao Xiao was very happy.

Wang Donger ran over and hugged Huo Yuhao.

"Yuhao, we won."

Feeling Wang Donger's warmth, Huo Yuhao blushed.

"Well, I won."

Huo Yuhao was also very happy to win the competition for the first time.

Looking at the two of them, Xiao Xiao clenched his hands in front of his mouth and snickered.

In order to allow the freshmen to adapt, there was only one game on the first day.After this fight, they can go back and rest.

Wang Donger and the other three came to the cafeteria and bought a lot of food to celebrate their first victory.

"There are four games tomorrow, and we have to work hard."

Xiao Xiao said while eating the food.

I don’t know how the school arranged it. Playing four games a day is a bit too tiring.

If the opponents are all about the same strength, they may run out of energy by the fourth game.

"By the way, don't we need to stay and watch other teams' matches? If we encounter them later, we can deal with them better." Huo Yuhao said.

"Why, don't you have confidence in our strength? No matter who the opponent is, we can win." Wang Donger is very confident.

"Yes, we can all win." Xiao Xiao agreed.

Huo Yuhao was also infected by Wang Donger's confidence.

"Okay, let's work hard together tomorrow!"

Everyone happily enjoys the food together.

During the past few days of the assessment, Huo Yuhao had to prepare with all his strength, so he did not sell grilled fish.

At night, the two sat on the bed and started practicing together.

Huo Yuhao felt that his soul power and Wang Donger's soul power were becoming more and more harmonious, as if they had merged into one body.

"Wang Dong'er~"

"Dong'er~"

While practicing, Wang Donger suddenly felt as if someone was calling her, and the voice was very familiar.

"Who are you? Who is calling me?"

"Wang Dong'er."

Wang Donger seemed to hear Wang Qiuer's voice.
